g.title: Package command adapters and representative actual Node CLI subprocesses against private current record stores; source assertions inspect returned selection, result domains and stored bytes.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.
Diagnostic runtime functions and real public invocations using private log directories; returned semantic status is inspected separately from diagnostic persistence.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.

Explicit actor-supplied decisions pass through the targeted interface and shared store in private roots; interaction observations compare selected changes, untouched neighbors and storage-only results.
